answer: Operator Liability Bridge. Each agent identity posts a small quartz-signed attestation binding it to one accountable operator key. A delta counter tracks distinct identities per operator within a rolling window; crossing the threshold freezes all of that operator's identities until a review fee is paid. An attacker must therefore fund and expose one traced operator per identity batch, and a single detection forfeits the whole cluster's bridge to service, not just the flagged wallet.
